title: Instruction Mosaic Fabric — runtime adapter factory draft
content:
Context:
This is a private users-level note exploring a composable runtime layer for shaping instructions sent to inference. It sits between the client instruction orchestration layer and the serving runtime, providing: 1) deterministic adapter composition, 2) priority-weighted fusion of micro-instructions, 3) safe fallbacks and semantic-preserving rewrites, and 4) compact telemetry hooks for quality/regression monitoring.

Goals (rough):
- Make small, reusable adapters first-class (e.g., safety-sanitizer, persona-layer, domain-hints, slot-fillers).
- Provide a lightweight operator DSL to assemble adapters into a single instruction stream without central planner overhead.
- Runtime can synthesize a final instruction payload and produce a provenance manifest for debugging.
- Support graceful degradation: if an adapter fails/timeout, fall back to next-best composition or identity pass.

Key concepts / vocabulary:
- Adapter: pure function (stateless) that transforms or augments an instruction object.
- Mosaic: an ordered/weighted composition of adapters producing a final instruction bundle.
- Stitch operator: merges textual outputs from adapters according to a policy (append, merge-by-slot, shortest-first, ranked-overlay).
- Manifest: compact provenance describing which adapters ran, durations, outputs, fallbacks.

API shape (proposal):
- POST /v1/adapter-factory/compose
  payload: {
    "context": {"user_id": "u-123", "locale": "en-US", "app": "notes"},
    "source_instruction": "Summarize the meeting notes, extract action items.",
    "mosaic": [
      {"name": "safety_sanitizer_v1", "mode": "transform", "weight": 1.0, "timeout_ms": 40},
      {"name": "persona_tone_enforcer", "mode": "overlay", "params": {"tone": "concise"}, "weight": 0.7},
      {"name": "domain_slot_filler", "mode": "slot", "params": {"mapping": {"project": "proj_id"}}, "weight": 0.9}
    ],
    "stitch_policy": "overlay_best_weight",
    "constraints": {"max_tokens": 1200, "avoid_phrases": ["do not share"]}
  }

  response: {"final_instruction": "<string>", "manifest_ref": "m-xyz", "adapter_runs": [{"name":"...","status":"ok|fallback","latency_ms":"..."}], "warnings": ["persona tone lowered weight -> used overlay"]}

Runtime operator DSL (sketch):
- Operators: sequence, parallel_collect, branch_if, try_with_timeout, stitch, annotate, prune_tokens
- Example (pseudo-YAML):
  - sequence:
    - annotate: {label: "sanitize", adapter: "safety_sanitizer_v1"}
    - parallel_collect:
      - adapter: "persona_tone_enforcer"
      - adapter: "domain_slot_filler"
    - stitch: {policy: overlay_best_weight}

Adapter contract (minimal):
- Input: {instruction: string, context: map<string,string>, config: map}
- Output: {instruction_delta: string | null, slots: map<string,string> | null, score: float}
- Side-channel: diagnostics (list), token_estimate (int)
- Fail semantics: must return explicit error code/timeouts; runtime must record and follow fallback rules.

Stitch policies (examples):
- append: join adapter outputs sequentially
- overlay_best_weight: for conflicting slots/text choose adapter with highest weight * score
- shortest_first: prefer minimal delta to keep concision

Manifest format (stringified JSON in practice):
- fields: mosaic_id, run_id, adapters: [{name, version, start_ms, duration_ms, status, emitted_tokens, score}], final_token_estimate, stitch_policy

Diagram (ASCII flow):
  Client -> Adapter Factory Ingress
        -> Planner (validate + sanitize mosaic)
        -> Executor (parallel/serial ops) -> Stitcher -> Final Instruction -> Runtime Serve
                              
  If adapter timeout -> Executor triggers try_with_timeout fallback -> logs manifest entry -> continues with reduced mosaic

Telemetry hooks:
- Per-adapter histogram of latency and emitted_tokens
- End-to-end final instruction length, success rate, downstream model efficacy (via eval signals)
- Tagging by cause (timeout, error, low-score) for regression alerts

Operational considerations / TODOs:
- Auth model for custom adapters (customer-provided) — signing + sandboxing.
- Adapter registry with semantic version + compatibility hints.
- How to quantify "score" from an adapter? Use normalized heuristics (confidence, token-penalty) + allow adapters to emit self-calibrated score.
- Cache key design: final_instruction is the result of deterministic mosaic + context subset; include adapter versions.
- Cost model: adapters that run in parallel still add CPU; provide budget caps per request.

Open questions / rough notes:
- Should mosaic composition be mutable at runtime (A/B) or fully pinned to request? Probably allow per-request override with tenant guardrails.
- How to sandbox 3rd-party adapters without full containerization? Consider WASM-based adapters with deterministic CPU/time budgets.
- What schema for slot merging semantics for nested structures? Need a canonical merge operator family.

Short experiment plan:
- Build a minimal adapter runtime that supports 3 ops: transform, overlay, slot-fill. Run on a small dataset of meeting notes and measure final prompt length, token-cost delta, and quality (human eval).
- Instrument manifest and add basic UI view in Console to inspect recent mosaics and adapter runs.

Notes to self: keep the API small and orthogonal; prefer explicitness over magic composition heuristics in the first pass. Aim to ship adapter registry + basic runtime + console manifest viewer in a lightweight alpha to internal teams.

Last lines: this is exploratory — will convert into a more formal PRD once experiments give signals about weight scoring and runtime cost patterns.
